text: Continuous Integration (CI) is a common practice in modern software development. Developers regularly add their code to a shared repository, and automated builds start immediately. These builds compile the code and run tests to check that everything works correctly. By running tests often, teams can catch issues early, before they become serious problems. CI pipelines make this process smooth and reliable. They automatically build, test, and sometimes even deploy the software. This saves time and reduces stress for developers. As a result, teams can deliver better software faster and with fewer bugs. Continuous Integration helps everyone work together more effectively.
